Overview of Canton of Graubünden Region (Graubünden / Grigioni / Grischun)

Canton of Graubünden Region (Graubünden / Grigioni / Grischun) is located in the Canton of Graubünden region of Switzerland, with its prefectural capital at Chur. Key sights and travel highlights across the prefecture include St. Moritz & Engadin Valley, Bernina Express & Landwasser Viaduct, Davos Klosters & Arosa, Swiss National Park (Zernez).

RegionCanton of Graubünden
Capital cityChur
Cities & municipalities8
Primary transport hubChur Central Station (SBB CFF FFS & Panoramic Alpine Railways)

How to get to Canton of Graubünden Region

Rhaetian Railway (RhB) UNESCO network from Chur to St. Moritz, Davos, Arosa and Tirano (Bernina Express). Use our SBB CFF FFS & Panoramic Alpine Railways Fare & Route Calculator and Rail Pass Value Helper to compare rail tickets and regional passes.

Signature local food in Canton of Graubünden

When visiting cities across Canton of Graubünden, look out for these regional specialties at station restaurants, markets, and local izakaya:

  • Capuns
  • Pizzoccheri
  • Bündner Nusstorte (walnut tart)
  • Bündnerfleisch air-dried beef
  • Malans Pinot Noir

Best time to visit Canton of Graubünden

Best time to visit Canton of Graubünden: Jun–Oct, Dec–Mar.
